chapters.title: Being Neighborly — Louisa May Alcott
chapters.notes: Draft study guide: Revise the plot, main characters, neighbourly kindness, helpfulness and the lesson about building good relationships. Add a detailed paragraph-wise summary, character sketches and textbook-based questions after checking the prescribed text.

chapters.title: On to the Summit: We Reach the Top — Tenzing Norgay
chapters.notes: Draft study guide: Focus on determination, teamwork, preparation, courage and the sequence of events during the expedition. Add a detailed summary, important incidents and comprehension questions from the prescribed text.

chapters.title: The Call of the Soil — Venkat Iyer
chapters.notes: Draft study guide: Study the writer’s connection with farming and soil, sustainable agriculture and respect for nature. Add a detailed summary, key terms, author’s viewpoint and text-based questions.

chapters.title: Pillars of Democracy — Dr. Babasaheb Ambedkar
chapters.notes: Draft study guide: Revise democracy, equality, liberty, fraternity, justice, constitutional values and responsible citizenship. Add the author’s argument, key points and text-based questions.

chapters.title: Mrs. Adis — Sheila Kaye-Smith
chapters.notes: Draft study guide: Prepare the plot, character sketch of Mrs. Adis, important incidents, conflict and central idea. Verify details against the textbook before writing final answers.

chapters.title: Tiger Hills — General Ved Prakash Malik
chapters.notes: Draft study guide: Study the Kargil conflict as presented in the lesson, soldiers’ role, leadership, courage and national responsibility. Add a chronological summary and text-based questions.

chapters.title: Cherry Tree — Ruskin Bond
chapters.notes: Poem study guide: Prepare the speaker/subject, growth and renewal, nature imagery and central idea. Poem appreciation should include title, poet, rhyme scheme, figures of speech, theme, favourite line and personal response; verify the rhyme scheme from the printed poem.

chapters.title: The Sower — Victor Hugo
chapters.notes: Poem study guide: Focus on the sower’s hard work, hope and dignity of labour. Prepare a stanza-wise explanation and appreciation with title, poet, rhyme scheme, figures of speech and central idea.

chapters.title: There is Another Sky — Emily Dickinson
chapters.notes: Poem study guide: Study the hopeful view of nature and the mind, imagery and contrast. Prepare stanza-wise explanation and complete poem appreciation.

chapters.title: Upon Westminster Bridge — William Wordsworth
chapters.notes: Poem study guide: Revise the speaker’s admiration of London at dawn, calm cityscape, imagery and personification. Prepare a stanza-wise explanation and complete appreciation.

chapters.title: Nose versus Eyes — William Cowper
chapters.notes: Poem study guide: Understand the humorous dispute, personification and message about cooperation. Revise the situation, speakers, humour and moral.

chapters.title: The Planners — Boey Kim Cheng
chapters.notes: Poem study guide: Study urban development, loss of history and individuality, imagery, contrast and the speaker’s attitude. Prepare a complete appreciation.

chapters.title: Expansion of Ideas
chapters.notes: Writing skill: Introduce the given thought, explain its meaning, develop it with logical points and examples, and conclude with a clear message. Maintain unity, coherence and correct grammar.

chapters.title: Blog Writing
chapters.notes: Writing skill: Use a suitable title, engaging introduction, organised paragraphs and a conclusion. Keep the tone appropriate to the audience and proofread language and facts.

chapters.title: E-mails
chapters.notes: Writing skill: Practise formal and informal email conventions as prescribed: recipient, subject, salutation, concise body, closing and name. Use a clear subject and polite tone.

chapters.title: Interview
chapters.notes: Writing skill: Prepare a short introduction and relevant questions in a logical order. Use clear question-answer formatting and respectful language.

chapters.title: Film Review
chapters.notes: Writing skill: Include film title, director, cast, genre, brief spoiler-free plot, acting, direction, music and a reasoned overall opinion.

chapters.title: The Art of Compering
chapters.notes: Writing skill: Practise opening an event, welcoming guests, introducing programme items and speakers, linking segments, giving acknowledgements and closing.

chapters.title: History of English Drama
chapters.notes: Drama: Revise the origin and development of English drama, major periods, playwrights and features of tragedy, comedy and other dramatic forms.

chapters.title: The Rising of the Moon — Lady Gregory
chapters.notes: Drama: Prepare the setting, plot, characters, conflict, dramatic tension and theme. Use the prescribed text for exact events and dialogue.

chapters.title: A Midsummer Night’s Dream — William Shakespeare
chapters.notes: Drama extract: Study the prescribed extract, characters, relationships, mistaken identities and comic elements. Restrict answers to events in the assigned extract.

chapters.title: An Enemy of the People — Henrik Johan Ibsen
chapters.notes: Drama extract: Study the prescribed extract’s conflict between truth, public opinion and social responsibility. Revise character motives and dramatic tension.

chapters.title: English Grammar
chapters.notes: Grammar study guide: Build from parts of speech, sentence structure, articles, prepositions and tenses to subject–verb agreement, clauses, active/passive voice, direct/indirect speech, transformations and punctuation. Add rules, examples and original practice exercises for each topic.

chapters.title: प्रेरणा
chapters.notes: अध्ययन मार्गदर्शिका: पाठ का सार, मुख्य भाव, प्रेरणा देने वाले विचार और पाठ से मिलने वाली सीख समझें। लेखक/कवि परिचय तथा पाठ्यपुस्तक-आधारित प्रश्न तैयार करें।

chapters.title: लघुकथाएँ — उषा की दीपावली और मुस्कुराती चोट
chapters.notes: दोनों लघुकथाओं की कथावस्तु, पात्र, घटनाक्रम और संदेश अलग-अलग समझें। तुलना करते समय दोनों कहानियों की विशेषताएँ लिखें।

chapters.title: पंद्रह अगस्त
chapters.notes: कविता का केंद्रीय भाव, स्वतंत्रता दिवस का महत्व और देशप्रेम की भावना समझें। कठिन शब्दों के अर्थ और भावार्थ का अभ्यास करें।

chapters.title: मेरा भला करने वालों से बचाएँ
chapters.notes: व्यंग्य की शैली, लेखक का दृष्टिकोण और दिखावे तथा वास्तविक भलाई के बीच अंतर समझें। सारांश और आशय-आधारित प्रश्न तैयार करें।

chapters.title: मध्ययुगीन काव्य — भक्ति महिमा
chapters.notes: भक्ति-भाव, ईश्वर के प्रति समर्पण और काव्य में व्यक्त जीवन-मूल्यों का भावार्थ लिखें।

chapters.title: मध्ययुगीन काव्य — बाल लीला
chapters.notes: कविता में बाल-स्वरूप का चित्रण, वात्सल्य भाव और काव्य-सौंदर्य समझें।

chapters.title: कलम का सिपाही
chapters.notes: पाठ का सार, साहित्यकार के व्यक्तित्व और लेखन के महत्व को समझें। प्रमुख घटनाएँ और पाठ का संदेश लिखें।

chapters.title: स्वागत है!
chapters.notes: कविता का भाव, स्वागत की भावना और मानवीय संबंधों का महत्व समझें। भावार्थ तथा शब्दार्थ का अभ्यास करें।

chapters.title: तत्सत
chapters.notes: कहानी के प्रतीक, कथानक, पात्र और मूल विचार समझें। पाठ से जुड़े अर्थ-आधारित प्रश्न तैयार करें।

chapters.title: गजलें — दोस्ती और मौजूद
chapters.notes: दोनों गजलों का भावार्थ, प्रमुख विचार, भाषा-शैली और गजल की विशेषताएँ समझें।

chapters.title: महत्त्वाकांक्षा और लोभ
chapters.notes: महत्त्वाकांक्षा तथा लोभ का अंतर, उनके परिणाम और लेखक का संदेश समझें। उदाहरण सहित उत्तर लिखने का अभ्यास करें।

chapters.title: भारती का सपूत
chapters.notes: पाठ का सार, प्रमुख व्यक्तित्व, योगदान और देश/समाज के प्रति जिम्मेदारी का भाव समझें।

chapters.title: सहर्ष स्वीकारा है
chapters.notes: कविता का केंद्रीय भाव, स्वीकृति, संघर्ष और जीवन-दृष्टि समझें। भावार्थ और काव्य-सौंदर्य का अभ्यास करें।

chapters.title: नुक्कड़ नाटक — मौसम और अनमोल जिंदगी
chapters.notes: नाटक का उद्देश्य, पात्र, संवाद, मंचन और सामाजिक संदेश समझें। दोनों नाटकों के कथानक अलग-अलग लिखें।

chapters.title: हिंदी में उज्ज्वल भविष्य की संभावनाएँ
chapters.notes: हिंदी भाषा के उपयोग, शिक्षा, रोजगार और संचार में संभावनाओं पर व्यवस्थित उत्तर तैयार करें।

chapters.title: समाचार : जन से जनहित तक
chapters.notes: समाचार का उद्देश्य, तथ्यपरकता, शीर्षक, समाचार लेखन की संरचना और जनहित का महत्व समझें।

chapters.title: रेडियो जॉकी
chapters.notes: रेडियो जॉकी की भूमिका, आवाज़, प्रस्तुति, श्रोताओं से संवाद और कार्यक्रम की रूपरेखा समझें।

chapters.title: ई-अध्ययन : नई दृष्टि
chapters.notes: डिजिटल अध्ययन के लाभ, चुनौतियाँ और जिम्मेदार उपयोग समझें। उत्तर में उदाहरण और संतुलित निष्कर्ष दें।

chapters.title: हिंदी व्याकरण और रचना
chapters.notes: अपठित गद्यांश/काव्यांश, शब्द-संपदा, मुहावरे, वाक्य-शुद्धि, काल, रस और अलंकार का अभ्यास करें। निबंध, पत्र, विज्ञापन, अनुवाद, संवाद और वृत्तांत के प्रारूप दोहराएँ।

chapters.title: मामू
chapters.notes: पाठाचा आशय, व्यक्तिचित्रातील मामूंचे स्वभाववैशिष्ट्य, महत्त्वाच्या घटना आणि लेखकाचा दृष्टिकोन समजून घ्या.

chapters.title: प्राणसई
chapters.notes: कवितेचा भावार्थ, निसर्गचित्रण, प्रतिमा आणि कवयित्रीची भावना स्पष्ट करा. रसग्रहणाचा सराव करा.

chapters.title: अशी पुस्तकं
chapters.notes: पुस्तकांचे महत्त्व, वाचनसंस्कृती आणि लेखकाचे विचार समजून घ्या. आशय व मुख्य मुद्दे लिहा.

chapters.title: झाडांच्या मनात जाऊ
chapters.notes: कवितेतील निसर्गप्रेम, झाडांचे महत्त्व आणि मानवी-निसर्ग संबंध यांचा भावार्थ समजून घ्या.

chapters.title: परिमळ
chapters.notes: लेखाचा आशय, भाषाशैली आणि लेखकाने मांडलेले विचार समजून घ्या. महत्त्वाचे मुद्दे नोंदवा.

chapters.title: दवांत आलीस भल्या पहाटीं
chapters.notes: कवितेतील निसर्गसौंदर्य, प्रतिमा, भावविश्व आणि काव्यवैशिष्ट्ये समजून घ्या.

chapters.title: ‘माणूस’ बांधूया!
chapters.notes: मानवी मूल्ये, सामाजिक ऐक्य आणि माणुसकीचा संदेश समजून घ्या. उदाहरणांसह उत्तर लिहा.

chapters.title: ऐसीं अक्षरें रसिकें
chapters.notes: अभंग/संतकाव्यातील विचार, भक्तिभाव आणि भाषासौंदर्य यांचा अर्थ समजून घ्या.

chapters.title: वहिनींचा ‘सुसाट’ सल्ला
chapters.notes: कथेतील विनोद, पात्रांचे स्वभाव, प्रसंग आणि लेखकाने निर्माण केलेला परिणाम समजून घ्या.

chapters.title: शब्द
chapters.notes: कवितेतील शब्दांचे सामर्थ्य, सामाजिक आशय आणि कवीची भूमिका स्पष्ट करा.

chapters.title: वाङ्मयीन लेण्याचा शिल्पकार
chapters.notes: व्यक्तिचित्र/चरित्रपर लेखातील व्यक्तीचे योगदान, साहित्यिक कार्य आणि लेखिकेचा दृष्टिकोन समजून घ्या.

chapters.title: पैंजण
chapters.notes: कवितेचा आशय, प्रतिमा आणि काव्यसौंदर्य समजून घ्या.

chapters.title: हसवाफसवी
chapters.notes: नाटकाचा कथानक, पात्रे, विनोदी प्रसंग, संवाद आणि नाट्यवैशिष्ट्ये लिहा.

chapters.title: ध्यानीमनी
chapters.notes: नाटकातील संघर्ष, पात्रांचे विचार, प्रसंगरचना आणि शीर्षकाचे औचित्य समजून घ्या.

chapters.title: सुंदर मी होणार
chapters.notes: नाटकाचा आशय, पात्रविकास, संवाद आणि मध्यवर्ती संदेश समजून घ्या.

chapters.title: सूत्रसंचालन
chapters.notes: कार्यक्रमाची सुरुवात, पाहुण्यांची ओळख, कार्यक्रमाचे दुवे, आभार आणि समारोप यांचा योग्य क्रम शिका.

chapters.title: मुद्रितशोधन
chapters.notes: मजकुरातील शुद्धलेखन, विरामचिन्हे, व्याकरण आणि मांडणीतील चुका शोधून दुरुस्त करण्याचा सराव करा.

chapters.title: अनुवाद
chapters.notes: मूळ अर्थ, संदर्भ आणि शैली कायम ठेवून अचूक व स्वाभाविक मराठी अनुवाद करा.

chapters.title: अनुदिनी (ब्लॉग) लेखन
chapters.notes: आकर्षक शीर्षक, प्रस्तावना, मुद्देसूद परिच्छेद आणि निष्कर्ष वापरून ब्लॉग लिहा.

chapters.title: रेडिओजॉकी
chapters.notes: निवेदन, आवाजातील चढ-उतार, श्रोत्यांशी संवाद आणि कार्यक्रमाची रचना समजून घ्या.

chapters.title: शब्दशक्ती
chapters.notes: शब्दांच्या अर्थछटा आणि संदर्भानुसार अर्थ समजून घ्या; पाठ्यपुस्तकातील उदाहरणे सोडवा.

chapters.title: काव्यगुण
chapters.notes: कवितेतील आशय, माधुर्य, प्रसाद, ओज इत्यादी काव्यगुणांची ओळख उदाहरणांसह करा.

chapters.title: वाक्यसंश्लेषण
chapters.notes: दोन किंवा अधिक वाक्ये अर्थ न बदलता योग्य रचनेने एकत्र करण्याचा सराव करा.

chapters.title: काळ
chapters.notes: वर्तमान, भूत आणि भविष्यकाळ तसेच त्यांचे उपप्रकार उदाहरणांसह ओळखा.

chapters.title: काव्याचे रसग्रहण
chapters.notes: कवितेचा विषय, कवी, मध्यवर्ती कल्पना, आवडलेली ओळ, भाषासौंदर्य आणि स्वतःची प्रतिक्रिया लिहा.

chapters.title: परिशिष्ट
chapters.notes: पाठ्यपुस्तकातील परिशिष्टातील संदर्भ, शब्दसूची आणि पूरक माहिती पुनरावृत्तीसाठी वापरा.

chapters.title: Introduction to Book-Keeping and Accountancy
chapters.notes: Book-keeping is the systematic recording of financial transactions. Accountancy includes recording, classifying, summarising, analysing and interpreting financial information. Revise objectives, users and basic accounting terms.

chapters.title: Meaning and Fundamentals of Double Entry Book-Keeping
chapters.notes: Every transaction has two aspects: debit and credit. The accounting equation is Assets = Liabilities + Capital. Revise the rules of debit and credit and the dual effect of transactions.

chapters.title: Journal
chapters.notes: The journal is the book of original entry. Record transactions chronologically with date, accounts, debit amount, credit amount and narration. Practise personal, real and nominal account rules.

chapters.title: Ledger
chapters.notes: A ledger contains individual accounts classified from journal entries. Learn posting, balancing accounts and preparing a trial balance from ledger balances.

chapters.title: Subsidiary Books
chapters.notes: Subsidiary books record similar transactions separately, such as cash book, purchases book, sales book and returns books. Understand which transactions belong in each book.

chapters.title: Bank Reconciliation Statement
chapters.notes: A Bank Reconciliation Statement explains differences between the cash book bank balance and pass book/bank statement balance. Identify timing differences, bank charges, direct deposits and errors.

chapters.title: Depreciation
chapters.notes: Depreciation is the systematic allocation of the depreciable amount of a fixed asset over its useful life. Study causes, need and prescribed methods with worked examples.

chapters.title: Rectification of Errors
chapters.notes: Errors may affect one or more accounts and may or may not affect the trial balance. Learn types of errors, suspense account where applicable and correcting entries.

chapters.title: Final Accounts of a Proprietary Concern
chapters.notes: Prepare Trading Account, Profit and Loss Account and Balance Sheet. Classify items correctly and account for adjustments such as closing stock, outstanding/prepaid expenses and depreciation.

chapters.title: Single Entry System
chapters.notes: The single entry system is an incomplete system of recording transactions. Study its features, limitations and the statement of affairs method for ascertaining profit or loss.

chapters.title: Introduction of Commerce and Business
chapters.notes: Understand human wants, economic activities, business, profession and employment. Revise characteristics, objectives and the role of commerce in connecting production and consumption.

chapters.title: Trade
chapters.notes: Trade is the buying and selling of goods and services. Study internal and international trade, wholesale and retail trade, and auxiliaries to trade such as transport, banking, insurance and warehousing.

chapters.title: Small Scale Industry and Business
chapters.notes: Study the meaning, characteristics, importance, opportunities and challenges of small-scale business. Understand its contribution to employment and regional development.

chapters.title: Forms of Business Organisation - I
chapters.notes: Compare sole trading concern and partnership on ownership, capital, liability, control, continuity and suitability. Learn the key features and limitations of each form.

chapters.title: Forms of Business Organisation - II
chapters.notes: Study joint stock companies and co-operative societies. Compare formation, ownership, liability, management, continuity and distribution of profits.

chapters.title: Institutes Supporting Business
chapters.notes: Understand how institutions support entrepreneurs and businesses through finance, training, guidance, infrastructure and marketing assistance. Learn each institution’s role from the textbook.

chapters.title: Business Environment
chapters.notes: Business environment includes internal and external forces affecting business decisions. Study economic, social, political, legal, technological and natural factors.

chapters.title: Introduction to Management
chapters.notes: Management involves planning, organising, staffing, directing and controlling resources to achieve objectives efficiently and effectively. Revise levels, importance and functions of management.

chapters.title: Secretary
chapters.notes: A secretary assists an organisation with communication, records, meetings and administrative coordination. Study qualities, duties, responsibilities and types of secretary.

chapters.title: Joint Stock Company
chapters.notes: A joint stock company is an incorporated association with separate legal identity and capital divided into shares. Revise features, merits, limitations and types.

chapters.title: Formation of a Company
chapters.notes: Study the stages of company formation: promotion, incorporation, capital subscription and commencement of business, as applicable to the prescribed company type.

chapters.title: Documents related to formation of a company
chapters.notes: Understand the purpose and contents of the Memorandum of Association, Articles of Association, prospectus and other prescribed formation documents.

chapters.title: Members of a company
chapters.notes: Study who can become a member, modes of membership, rights, duties and termination of membership. Distinguish a member from a shareholder where relevant.

chapters.title: Directors and Key Managerial personnel of a company
chapters.notes: Study appointment, qualifications, powers, duties and responsibilities of directors and key managerial personnel as prescribed. Verify statutory details against the current textbook.

chapters.title: Company Meetings - I
chapters.notes: Revise the meaning, importance, types and basic procedure of company meetings. Study notice, agenda, quorum and chairperson as prescribed.

chapters.title: Company Meetings - II
chapters.notes: Study resolutions, minutes, voting and other meeting procedures in the textbook. Distinguish ordinary and special resolutions where applicable.

chapters.title: Business Communication Skills of Secretary
chapters.notes: Study oral, written and non-verbal communication, listening, drafting and professional etiquette required for secretarial work.

chapters.title: Correspondence with Directors
chapters.notes: Practise formal letters and communications addressed to directors. Follow the prescribed format, clear subject, polite tone and concise body.

chapters.title: Correspondence with Banks
chapters.notes: Study the purpose and format of routine business correspondence with banks. Practise clear, accurate and formal drafting.

chapters.title: Correspondence with Statutory Authorities
chapters.notes: Study formal correspondence with statutory authorities. Use accurate references, clear requests, supporting details and a professional closing.

chapters.title: Basic Concepts in Economics
chapters.notes: Study the meaning, scope and basic concepts of economics, including wants, utility, goods, wealth, scarcity and choice. Learn definitions and suitable examples.

chapters.title: Money
chapters.notes: Revise the meaning, functions and types of money, evolution of money and its role in exchange and the economy.

chapters.title: Partition Values
chapters.notes: Study partition values as statistical measures that divide an ordered data set into equal parts. Revise the textbook’s definitions, formulae and solved examples.

chapters.title: The Economy of Maharashtra
chapters.notes: Study the structure and features of Maharashtra’s economy, major sectors, resources, development and regional differences using textbook data.

chapters.title: Rural Development in India
chapters.notes: Understand the meaning, importance and challenges of rural development. Study agriculture, infrastructure, employment and rural development measures described in the textbook.

chapters.title: Population in India
chapters.notes: Revise population size, distribution, density, growth, composition and demographic features. Use textbook figures with their stated reference year.

chapters.title: Unemployment in India
chapters.notes: Study the meaning, types, causes and effects of unemployment and measures for employment generation described in the textbook.

chapters.title: Poverty in India
chapters.notes: Understand poverty, its measurement, causes, effects and poverty-alleviation measures. Distinguish textbook definitions and indicators.

chapters.title: Economic Policy of India Since 1991
chapters.notes: Study liberalisation, privatisation and globalisation, the reasons for reforms and their effects on the Indian economy.

chapters.title: Economic Planning in India
chapters.notes: Revise the objectives, strategies, institutions and broad phases of economic planning in India as explained in the textbook.

chapters.title: Basics of Information Technology
chapters.notes: Study the meaning and components of IT, data and information, hardware, software, input/output devices, storage, networks and basic digital concepts.

chapters.title: Introduction to DBMS
chapters.notes: Understand databases, DBMS functions, tables, records, fields, keys and basic database operations. Practise textbook examples and terminology.

chapters.title: Impressive Web Designing
chapters.notes: Study the structure of web pages, HTML fundamentals, common elements, hyperlinks, images, tables and basic design principles as prescribed.

chapters.title: Cyber Law
chapters.notes: Study the purpose of cyber law, digital rights and responsibilities, cyber offences and safe, lawful use of digital systems. Keep the notes informational and prevention-focused.

chapters.title: SOP: Daily Computing (LibreOffice)
chapters.notes: Practical guide: Learn the prescribed office-suite tasks, document creation, formatting, spreadsheets and presentations. Follow the textbook practical steps and screenshots.

chapters.title: SOP: Web Designing (HTML-5)
chapters.notes: Practical guide: Practise the prescribed HTML5 page structure and elements using the textbook exercises. Validate tags and page output.

chapters.title: SOP: Client Side Scripting (JavaScript)
chapters.notes: Practical guide: Study basic client-side scripting concepts, syntax and textbook exercises. Practise simple examples in a safe local learning environment.

chapters.title: SOP: Accounting Package (GNUKhata)
chapters.notes: Practical guide: Study the prescribed accounting-package interface and textbook tasks for recording and viewing accounting information.

chapters.title: SOP: Digital Content Creation (GIMP, Inkscape)
chapters.notes: Practical guide: Learn the prescribed image-editing and vector-graphics concepts and complete textbook activities.

chapters.title: SOP: DBMS (PostgreSQL)
chapters.notes: Practical guide: Study the database software and prescribed SQL/database tasks. Practise only the commands and exercises included in the course.

chapters.title: Appendix: Installation Steps and Abbreviations
chapters.notes: Use the appendix as a reference for textbook installation guidance, terminology and abbreviations. Check software-version differences before following installation steps.

chapters.title: Development of Physical Fitness
chapters.notes: Study the components of physical fitness, their importance and safe ways of developing them. Understand the purpose of fitness assessment and regular activity.

chapters.title: Obesity
chapters.notes: Study the meaning, contributing factors, health effects, prevention and the importance of supportive, healthy habits. Avoid stigma and body comparisons.

chapters.title: Nature and Diet
chapters.notes: Revise balanced nutrition, food groups, hydration and the relationship between diet, activity and wellbeing. Use age-appropriate, non-restrictive health guidance.

chapters.title: Yoga and Mudra
chapters.notes: Study the meaning, principles and general benefits of yoga and mudras. Follow qualified instruction and avoid attempting painful or unsuitable practices.

chapters.title: Doping (Stimulants)
chapters.notes: Study the meaning of doping, fairness in sport, health risks, anti-doping principles and prevention. This chapter is informational; do not use performance-enhancing substances.

chapters.title: Injury Management
chapters.notes: Understand common sports-injury categories, prevention, the importance of stopping activity when injured and seeking qualified medical assessment. Follow the textbook’s safety guidance.

chapters.title: Modern Technology - Activism
chapters.notes: Study the role of modern technology in physical activity and sport, including monitoring, training support, media and responsible use. Verify the exact chapter wording in the book.

chapters.title: Career Opportunities in Sports
chapters.notes: Explore the sports-related career areas listed in the textbook, required skills, education and professional responsibilities.

chapters.title: Various Games
chapters.notes: Revise the games included in the textbook, their basic rules, playing areas, equipment and skills. Confirm the exact list from the textbook.

chapters.title: Various Sports Competitions
chapters.notes: Study types and organisation of sports competitions, basic formats, roles and sporting values as described in the textbook.

chapters.title: Success Stories of Sportsmen
chapters.notes: Use the textbook profiles to identify achievements, discipline, teamwork, resilience and lessons from sports careers.

chapters.title: Practical Work
chapters.notes: Complete the practical activities, records and assessments prescribed by the school and textbook under teacher supervision.

chapters.title: Environment and Sustainable Development
chapters.notes: Study the meaning and components of environment, human-environment relationships and sustainable development. Revise principles and everyday examples.

chapters.title: Ecosystems
chapters.notes: Understand ecosystem structure, biotic and abiotic components, food chains, food webs, energy flow and ecological balance.

chapters.title: Biodiversity
chapters.notes: Study the meaning, levels, importance, threats and conservation of biodiversity. Distinguish in-situ and ex-situ conservation.

chapters.title: Natural Resources
chapters.notes: Revise renewable and non-renewable resources, their uses, conservation and sustainable management.

chapters.title: Disasters
chapters.notes: Study natural and human-made disasters, preparedness, risk reduction, response and recovery. Focus on safety and official guidance.

chapters.title: Glossary
chapters.notes: Use the glossary to revise key environmental terms and their textbook definitions.

chapters.title: Project Guidelines and List
chapters.notes: Follow the textbook and teacher’s instructions for selecting, researching, documenting and presenting an environmental project.
